format_doc: points: corrects -> AIR ladder for one exam session (monotone: more corrects => better (smaller) AIR)
air values are CROWD-COMPILED ESTIMATES (approximate where air_qualifier='~'), never ground truth
cross_check_points: additional session points kept for consistency reporting only, never runtime

source.compiler_statement: compiled from Reddit, Telegram... because officially nothing has been revealed by AIIMS
source.extracted_by: four-agent research sweep (rank-predictor-data-research.html, 2026-09-18) — audio-extracted ladder points; descriptions carry zero data
source.reliability_disclaimer: the author himself disclaims predictive reliability; treat as a wide labelled prior only

notes: RUNTIME uses the seven 2025-07 points ONLY — they pair with the official distribution anchor DS-INICET-DISTRIBUTION-202507-v1 (same session)
the 2026-01 marks points are cross-check only: no official 2026 distribution exists to pair them with (M2 Phase 1 gap)
UR-only prior: weaker for reserved categories (spec 9) — the strategy flags this in warnings whenever a non-UR category is present
marks<->corrects arithmetic (pattern 200Q +1/-1/3, no-skip): marks = corrects - (200 - corrects)/3; 160c=146.7m, 150c=133.3m, 110c=80m
